history.summary: Freehold 'Bliss@Kovan 2BR' listed at an improbable 1765 sqft for $2.3M / $1303 PSF — almost certainly a mislabelled/oversized strata or ground-floor/PES unit, not a normal 2BR. The seemingly cheap PSF (vs $1648 median) is an artefact of that oversized area, and the 1.30% URA CAGR is alarmingly weak.
history.rating_rationale: Two red flags compound: (1) the 1.30% resale CAGR (29 txns) is far below any baseline — this development has materially underperformed; and (2) 1765 sqft for a '2BR' is a bedroom-sqft mismatch, so the $1303 'cheap' PSF is misleading and the $2.3M quantum buys very poor PSF value for the unit type. Freehold and Kovan MRT (590m) are the only positives. Weak appreciation history plus a misclassified, oversized unit at a $2.3M quantum is a poor investment.

history.summary: Freehold 614 sqft 1BR in a 2015 boutique (140-unit) D19 project walkable to Kovan/Hougang MRT. Asking $1,531 psf is right at the verified 1BR average (~$1,549 psf, range $1,141-1,906), so the algo's -11% cheap signal is a thin-comp artifact rather than a true discount.
history.rating_rationale: Web checks show Bliss@Kovan 1BR transactions averaged ~$1,549 psf over the last 12 months (range $1,141-1,906), making the $1,531 psf asking at-market, not the -11% bargain the model implies. psf_cohort_txns=0 (no exact-size comp) and only 29 appreciation txns mean both the cheap and the appreciation reads (1.3% CAGR) are low-information. Positives are genuine: freehold tenure, walkable Kovan MRT (NEL) plus Hougang interchange, mature Heartland amenities, and OCR-region forward tailwind. But freehold is not a forward edge per the backtest, the cheapness doesn't hold up against real transactions, and weak 1.3% trailing appreciation gives no momentum story. Fairly priced, decent location, no value edge.
